Rotate new keys or new certificates.
Close stale tickets and stale branches.
Escalate urgent incidents or urgent alerts.
Retry failed jobs and failed checks.
Verify signed requests or signed responses.
Publish approved changes and approved releases.
Restore archived records or archived exports.
Compare Alice's invoices and Alice's receipts.
Archive Bob's notes or Bob's drafts.
Revoke Dana's tokens and Dana's sessions.
Merge Sam's patches or Sam's branches.

Refresh source tables and source views.
Clear local caches or local indexes.

manifest.selection: Sixteen wholly fresh type-live coordination boundaries were frozen before tokenizer import or count exposure, balanced four per modifier class and eight per conjunction. Every English arm leaves the second conjunct's modifier scope live; every Ainglish arm repeats that modifier. Every finite cell will be filed.
manifest.method: Under tiktoken 0.14.0, compute tokens(repeated-modifier repair)-tokens(bare live boundary) for each complete pair in cl100k_base, o200k_base, and p50k_base. Compute an equal-item mean per tokenizer and use the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable headline. Report every member and diagnostic class cell regardless of direction.
